final: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT s.sentreg, s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg_ownership FROM joined_data), order_type_avg AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) as order_type_avg_ownership FROM joined_data GROUP BY ordertypedist), filtered_cases AS (SELECT jd.instownpct, jd.ordertypedist, oa.overall_avg_ownership, ota.order_type_avg_ownership FROM joined_data jd CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa JOIN order_type_avg ota ON jd.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist WHERE jd.instownpct > oa.overall_avg_ownership) SELECT AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership, AVG(instownpct / order_type_avg_ownership) as avg_ratio_to_order_type_avg, AVG(instownpct - overall_avg_ownership) as avg_excess_over_overall FROM filtered_cases
